---
title: 'mrbayesStop'
description: 'Stop a MrBayes run started by `mrbayesRun`'
toc: true
toc-depth: 3
---


```{r}
#| eval: false
catGenes::mrbayesStop()
```

### Description

Convenience wrapper to stop a MrBayes run returned by `mrbayesRun`.
For programmatic stopping, the run must have been started with processx
(i.e., `use.processx = TRUE`) and, for practical "stop anytime" control,
`background = TRUE`.

A graceful stop (`force = FALSE`) interrupts MrBayes and answers "yes" to
its *"Do you really want to stop the run (y/n)?"* prompt, so the run ends
cleanly and the samples written so far are kept. If MrBayes has not exited
after 10 seconds, it is killed.

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| res | A result object returned by `mrbayesRun`. |
| force | Logical. If `FALSE` (default), requests a graceful stop. If `TRUE`, force-kills the process. |

### Value

Invisibly returns `TRUE` if a stop signal was sent, otherwise `FALSE`.
